Stock market news | Record Foreign Inflows lift rupee, Sensex jumps 13%

On 21 November 2026, record foreign inflows into Indian markets were reported, boosting the rupee and lifting the Sensex. The inflows were described as the highest for the month.
Strong foreign capital supports currency strength and market confidence, indicating positive sentiment for investors and reinforcing the market's upward momentum.
